description: Fork of exp149 (d_qk=992 per-side STE, sparse scatter, 279M, plateaued ~+0.05 behind exp144). Replace element-wise STESign with DominanceCanonicalize(d_head=32). Reframe: qk_lut emits a 2*d_qk = 992-wide output per head, split into two 496-dim 'raw dominance' vectors (Q-dom, K-dom). Each is canonicalized via D2V(Borda+LN) -> V2D-STE, projecting onto the realizable-dominance manifold and yielding 496-dim ±1 vectors on-manifold. d_qk: 992 -> 496 (now per-side, matches exp144 convention; P=496 with d_head=32 matches exp144's V2D output). qk_lut sparse-scatter destination: 2*d_qk = 992 (was 1984). Per-output votes: H*tph*n_sparse/(2*d_qk) = 6*384*32/992 ≈ 74 (was 37). DominanceCanonicalize adds ~128 LN params/layer (negligible). Architectural compare to exp144: exp144's qk_lut emits 32 Borda reals/side then constructively V2D's to 496 ±1. exp151's qk_lut emits 496 raw dominance votes/side via sparse scatter, then projects onto the d_head=32 Borda manifold via D2V->V2D-STE. Hypothesis: freeing qk_lut from the 32-Borda emission bottleneck while keeping on-manifold attention input recovers exp144's structure with more LUT-side capacity. attn_scale_init=0.4 kept (matches exp144's empirical value for 496-dim ±1 attention).
